title: True or false: Capital cities, Asia
intro: Decide whether each statement about Asia is true. Every answer shows its source.

statements.text: Beijing is the capital of China.
statements.explain: Beijing is the capital of China.

statements.text: Kabul is the capital of Georgia.
statements.explain: The capital of Georgia is Tbilisi, not Kabul.

statements.text: Colombo is the capital of Sri Lanka.
statements.explain: Colombo is the capital of Sri Lanka.

statements.text: Dushanbe is the capital of United Arab Emirates.
statements.explain: The capital of United Arab Emirates is Abu Dhabi, not Dushanbe.

statements.text: Dhaka is the capital of Bangladesh.
statements.explain: Dhaka is the capital of Bangladesh.

statements.text: Dili is the capital of India.
statements.explain: The capital of India is New Delhi, not Dili.

statements.text: Naypyidaw is the capital of Myanmar.
statements.explain: Naypyidaw is the capital of Myanmar.

statements.text: Nicosia is the capital of Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
statements.explain: The capital of Democratic People's Republic of Korea is Pyongyang, not Nicosia.

statements.text: Kuala Lumpur is the capital of Malaysia.
statements.explain: Kuala Lumpur is the capital of Malaysia.

statements.text: Amman is the capital of Lebanon.
statements.explain: The capital of Lebanon is Beirut, not Amman.
